main_text.p: Virtutis namq; cum Illustribus Familiis Ve-stris tam felix hactenus connubium fuit, ut Virtutem oportéat ante suì naturam exuere, quam à Vobis abscedere, Vitia honesta reddi, quam à Vobis recipi. Idem meri-torum in rem humanam tam fertile fuit, ut nullum tempus futurum sit, quod eorum de-meminisse valeat. Quis enim avitam SCHÖN-AICHIORUM Pietatem, Quis SCHÖNAICHIO-RUM & BIBRANIORUM in Patriam & Augustis-simum PatriæPrincipem fidem ignorat? Quos ergo seligerem potius Patronos labori in Vir-tutis cultura versanti, qui in exemplum per-fectissimum Virtutum statis, qui quod gene-re Vestro summe dignum est unice volvitis? Accedit utrorumq; maxima erga me meosq; Gratia, cujus recentem fructum in suavi con-victu & commilitio sensi, quo Tu HENRI-CE ALEXANDER, BARO BIBRANI, & Tu JOHANNES GEORGI, BARO SCHÖN-AICHI, inter Labores Academicos Vestros me biennio & amplius dignati fuistis. Macti este Virtute Vestra, Domini Benignissimi, & qui Portum Studiorum jam cominus videtis

page.notes: Faded, show-through text from the reverse page is visible in the middle of the column and was omitted. The last word "tis" at the right is a catchword. Some words in the lower half are lightly faded and read with uncertainty; "Mácti" is read as "Macti" and "statis" appears as printed.
